new_page.h1: Albion Houses for Sale | Maple Ridge Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Albion. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Albion, Maple Ridge: 59 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 12 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 3 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Albion rose from 56 in June to 59 in October (+5.4%), and 35 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 15.2% of Maple Ridge’s 388 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Albion?
Albion also had 10 condos and townhomes listed and 3 sold in October, against 59 houses listed. The Albion condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Albion home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

78 houses sold in Albion with a median price of $1,244,000 (the middle half sold between $990,000 and $1,379,750), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $402 per square foot, a median year built of 2006 and a median lot of 4,012 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Albion?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 59 houses listed in Albion. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Albion a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Albion had a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Albion from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 35 houses sold in Albion over those 5 months, out of 247 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Albion?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Albion sell for?
faq.a: 78 houses sold in Albion between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,244,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Albion?
faq.a: The median was 19 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.7% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
